About Me

Building the future of customer intelligence

I'm a global product marketing leader specializing in data storytelling — helping companies understand, articulate, and capitalize on the power of customer data.

With over two decades in marketing technology, I've built and scaled go-to-market strategies for some of the most transformative data platforms in the industry. From early-stage startups to enterprise giants, my focus has always been the same: connecting the dots between complex technology and real business outcomes.

Currently, I serve as VP, Marketing / Head of Planning, Analytics & Intelligent Applications at SAP, where I lead strategy, marketing, and commercialization for extended planning and analytics within SAP Business Data Cloud. Previously, I spent nearly six years at Salesforce as VP of Global Product Marketing, leading the Data & Identity portfolio and helping drive $2.3B in pipeline.

I'm also the author of two award-winning business books — Customer Data Platforms (Wiley) and Data-Driven (McGraw Hill, Axiom Silver Medal winner) — as well as six books on food and drink published by Random House.

When I'm not thinking about data, you'll find me perfecting my rib recipe, mixing cocktails, or cheering on my son at tennis tournaments.
